author: Bill Ferguson
name: script_manager
description: Provides a lighttable interface to scan, start, stop, install, and update darktable's Lua scripts organized by folder.
description-extensive: This is the control panel for all of darktable's add-on scripts. It scans your scripts folders and gives you simple on/off buttons to turn each script on or off, and it can also download extra script collections and keep everything up to date. If you ever want to switch a script off, you just click its button instead of editing configuration files by hand.
